'''Rosala''' is a servant from [[Seanchan]] who worked for [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]].

==Activities==
When [[Liandrin]] fails to show the proper Seanchan respect to the High Lady, Suroth sends Liandrin to Rosala to be beaten.
